166:t_108:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, you idiot! You deserve a little pain!」

166:t_109:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! The day has finally come!」

166:t_109:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$... Let me ask you one thing.」

166:t_109:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「You said you'd stop me if I went too far. Is this that moment?」

166:t_109:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「You can't answer...? I'm not so cheap that a man like you could kill me.」

166:t_109:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up! You'll be my stepping stone!」

166:t_109:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass you and prove I'm a greater man than you!」

166:t_110:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ$$! Your fighting spirit is different from last time...!」

166:t_110:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll leave persuading you to $$クェス$$ and the Colonel! I'll teach you how pointless it is to fight alone!」

166:t_110:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't give me that! Save that talk until you've defeated me!」

166:t_111:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$... Is this really where a Super $$コーディネイター$$ like you belongs?」

166:t_111:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have my share of contacts in $$プラント$$. So I know the truth about $$コーディネイター$$s, too.」

166:t_111:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「What is this truth about $$コーディネイター$$s...?!」

166:t_111:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ignorance is bliss. But it can sometimes be a sin.」

166:t_111:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you fail to fulfill your mission, you'll one day face the punishment you deserve.」
